Upstream: https://github.com/basil00/WinDivert/releases/tag/v2.2.2
Binary distribution: WinDivert-2.2.2-A.zip (x64 directory).
License choice for this distribution: GNU LGPL version 3.
The complete upstream license text is in LICENSE. Corresponding upstream source
is included in WinDivert-2.2.2-source.tar.gz (tag v2.2.2).

EasyHotspot dynamically loads Native/WinDivert.dll. Users may replace the library
and driver with compatible versions. Reverse engineering for debugging changes
to this LGPL library is permitted. WinDivert has not been modified.
